target_customer: US healthcare providers wanting to automate patient billing and collections calls
problem: Providers lose margin to weak patient billing and collections; Argovox used voice and text AI agents for multi-turn billing conversations.
business_model: B2B SaaS for healthcare providers (pricing not found)

founders.name: Luis Pellerano
founders.background_notes: M&A and capital markets attorney for 8 plus years per YC page, built the voice agent.

founders.name: Noe Branagan
founders.background_notes: Engineering leader with 10 plus years of experience per YC page.

exit.reason: Not public; one tracker says the company quietly wound down while the founders moved to adjacent work (Ruffo), unverified.

technical_complexity.rationale: Multi-turn voice agents for billing in 2022 predated modern LLM voice stacks and required telephony and compliance work.

defensibility.rationale: No data or integration moat is documented; later entrants such as Cedar and Collectly built similar agents.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Cedar launched its Kora voice agent in April 2025 and Collectly its Billie agent; Argovox was already inactive.

market_need_then: Providers had large patient balances and manual collections, but no dated 2022 source of demand for voice AI was found.

branding.domain_note: argovox.com no longer resolves (lookup failed in 2026)

brand_strength.rationale: No brand evidence found; name is similar to Argos, Argox and other unrelated brands in search results.

pivots.to: Ruffo cross-border real estate signature app
pivots.why: Reported by YC founder profile and a tracker; reason not stated.

outcome_analysis: Argovox targeted healthcare billing with voice agents in 2022, ahead of the LLM voice wave, and is now inactive. The cause is not public; a tracker suggests a quiet wind down with the founders turning to Ruffo, but with no funding, traction or post-mortem data a failure cause cannot be assigned.
notes: Website host did not resolve so treated as dead without workaround. A single tracker plus CB Insights and VCBacked mention a 500K pre-seed from Y Combinator in Sept 2022 and revenue figures, unverified so not recorded as a round. Founder names conflict (Nelson Munoz appears only on the tracker). Competitor search found only 2025 era vendors, none dated near 2022, so the list is empty and later entrants are in takeover_risk_then.
